title: Reception of an EMM STATUS message by an EMM entity

entities.name: EMM STATUS
entities.description: EMM STATUS message is used to report certain error conditions detected upon receipt of EMM protocol data. It can be sent by both the MME and the UE.

entities.name: EMM status procedure
entities.description: Procedure for sending and receiving EMM STATUS messages between UE and MME to report error conditions in EMM protocol data.

entities.name: Error conditions detected
entities.description: Certain error conditions detected upon receipt of EMM protocol data that trigger the sending of EMM STATUS message.

entities.name: No state transition
entities.description: On receipt of an EMM STATUS message, no state transition shall be taken as seen from the radio interface.

entities.name: No specific action
entities.description: On receipt of an EMM STATUS message, no specific action shall be taken as seen from the radio interface.

entities.name: Local actions possible
entities.description: Local actions are possible upon receipt of EMM STATUS message, but these are implementation dependent for both MME and UE.

relations.description: EMM status procedure involves sending and receiving EMM STATUS messages
EMM STATUS message is triggered by detection of error conditions in EMM protocol data

Receipt of EMM STATUS message results in no specific action from radio interface perspective
